bio: Careys Manor Hotel is a hotel and spar with heritage and heart that has been built by its rural location in the centre of Brockenhurst. Its beautiful semi-tropical landscape is a perfect place for relaxation whilst dining on the hotels Afternoon Tea. The Hotel has a combined focus on spar and dining services, allowing the customer to divulge in both avenues whilst enjoying the freshy made Afternoon Tea.  The hotel is surrounded by majestic farmland and villages that dd to its picturesque landscape. The Afternoon Tea is served in a elegantly furnished part of the hotel with many nature inspired elements. They have options to eat outdoors which makes the Afternoon Tea a must whilst staying at the Careys Manor Hotel.  The Careys Manor Hotel is a 5 minute walk away from he Brockenhurst station allowing for quick access to the surrounding towns and cities.
